system.description: You emit a short-range burst of cold in all directions from yourself. Make an Intellect attack against any number of creatures in range; success means they take 5 damage from cold. Each level of Effort you use for extra damage increases the damage by 2 points, or 1 point on a failed attack. Effort: Attempt to blind all targets you successfully hit (a successful second attack roll against a target means they are blinded, hindering all vision-based tasks by two steps, until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery). Action.
